title: English Practice Quiz 0704
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
questions.explanation: The comparative form of the short adjective tall is taller.

questions.question: What does 'borrow' mean?
options: take something temporarily and return it
questions.explanation: Borrow means to take something for a period and return it.

questions.question: When I was five, I ___ swim.
How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the apostrophe correctly?
options: The guards' uniform is blue. (one guard)
questions.explanation: Guard's shows possession by one guard.

questions.question: I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.question: At 8 p.m. yesterday, I ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: Use the past continuous for an action in progress at a specific past time.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The road is very ___. There are many cars.
questions.explanation: Crowded means filled with many people or things; it can describe busy roads.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.
